parsed.summary: The PR resolves the minversion issue by switching to pkg_resources.parse_version, which is a more robust solution. It includes new reproduction and edge case test files.

issues.description: The PR introduces a dependency on pkg_resources, which may not be desirable for all users. However, given the context, this is a reasonable trade-off for fixing the issue.
